about_the_game:
This demo contains two areas: the city and the circus. You take on the role of a child so your survival depends on careful movement, stealth, and exploration. Furthermore, this demo includes one of the three endings and one of the three difficulties compared to the final game.

THE NIGHTMARE
Take on the role of Mike, a lonely child who has suffered a tragic accident. Now in critical condition, your thoughts fixate on a single dream: a visit to the circus. As your life hangs by a thread, a demonic entity grants your final wish, but it wants your pure soul in return.

The circus you longed for is fusing with your memories, twisting into your worst nightmare. You must survive and escape... before it consumes you.

 
BEWARE OF THE CLOWN
The demon has taken the form of a monstrous clown, stalking through your thoughts and drawn to the slightest sound. Move carefully, and use your small size for hiding to evade it.

 
COLLECT THE POSTERS
Hidden circus posters act as seals, keeping you trapped in this mental prison. Gathering them all is your only chance to clear your mind and survive.

 
KEY FEATURES FOR THE FULL GAME

  • Ever-present monstrous clown that can hear you..

  • Tense stealth gameplay focused on sneaking, hiding, and escaping.

  • Freeform exploration. The eerie circus is an open area to discover as you want.

  • Multiple endings. Immerse yourself in a dramatic story.

GAME LENGTH
20-60 minutes.

short_description: Take on the role of Mike, a lonely child trapped in his worst nightmare: a sinister circus. Move carefully and stay hidden to survive the demonic clown stalking you. Explore the circus and uncover its secrets to save your life.
